title: Noun だけ〜 (〜dake)
longExplanation: The Noun だけ grammar point is used to emphasize the idea of 'only', 'just', or 'merely' in a sentence. It can be attached to nouns, verbs, い-adjectives, and な-adjectives to show this emphasis. This grammar point is commonly used in both spoken and written Japanese.
formation: Noun + だけ, Verb-casual + だけ, い-Adjective + だけ, な-Adjective-な + だけ

examples.jp: コーヒーだけ飲んで、帰りました。
examples.en: I only drank coffee and went home.

examples.jp: この本は二十ページだけ読んだ。
examples.romaji: Kono hon wa nijuu peeji dake yonda.
examples.en: I only read twenty pages of this book.

examples.jp: 彼女はとても速いですが、走るだけでなく、考えるのも速いです。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa totemo hayai desu ga, hashiru dake denaku, kangaeru no mo hayai desu.
examples.en: She is very fast, not only at running but also at thinking.

examples.jp: この部屋は寝るだけの場所です。
examples.romaji: Kono heya wa neru dake no basho desu.
examples.en: This room is a place only for sleeping.
